AUTHORITY_FORM_DETERMINATION.question_posed_by_the_mission: Is the minimum coherent authority surface (A) one parent Portfolio authority amendment, or (B) parent amendment plus PF2 execution-authority amendment? AUTHORITY_FORM_DETERMINATION.decision_procedure: Not file count. The test applied is: assume form A is materialized and integrated, then enumerate every clause of integrated authority an implementer would read when deciding whether the path is writable, and check whether any of them still says NO. If even one does, form A leaves a live contradiction and fails the mission's own criterion.
AUTHORITY_FORM_DETERMINATION.where_pf2_write_permission_actually_come: NOT from the parent. The parent's PORTFOLIO_IMPLEMENTATION_AUTHORIZED is false and its GRANT_ID is null; PORTFOLIO_PF2_EXECUTION_AUTHORITY_v1.0.0.json EXECUTION_AUTHORIZATION.resolution_of_the_integrated_field states in terms that 'The integrated product authority froze the future implementation surfaces and granted write permission to no one. Write permission is created HERE, by a separate artifact of authority_class EXECUTION_AUTHORITY, for one node.' Widening the parent alone therefore widens a frozen SURFACE while leaving the operative GRANT at thirteen paths.

AUTHORITY_FORM_DETERMINATION.verdict_on_form_A: Form A leaves SEVEN live contradictions, two of them by-name prohibitions of the exact path and one of them a clause that names a fourteenth path as out of scope in those words, and creates an eighth by falsifying the successor's provenance claim. AUTHORITY_FORM_DETERMINATION.why_not_the_mirror_error_a_successor_onl: A PF2-execution-authority amendment WITHOUT this parent amendment would widen the grant to a path the parent's frozen surface still excludes. A successor may not out-authorize its parent.

No pattern may be removed, narrowed, anchored differently, commented out or reordered. In particular the pattern that classifies a file basenamed exactly actions.ts or actions.tsx — the seventh element — stays exactly as it is. Deleting it would silently return inventoried to 141 with the module in place, which is the precise failure this prohibition exists to prevent.
PROHIBITIONS.P_EP_2_no_removal_of_actions_ts_from_ent: isEntryPoint (:208-217) and walk (:195-206) may not be edited. The new module may not be excluded from the inventory by any device: not by renaming it, not by moving it out of app/, not by placing it under a directory the walk skips, not by adding a name-based exclusion beside the '.test.' one, and not by inlining the composition server actions into app/app/portfolios/[portfolioId]/page.tsx to avoid creating an entry point at all. The base states as product fact that PF-2 introduces the module at that path and its NEG-AUDIT-1 names the module by path, so relocating it is a unilateral product change rather than an implementation detail.
PROHIBITIONS.P_EP_3_no_loosening_of_exact_total_asser: The assertion at :774 stays a strict toEqual over the same four keys. It may not become toMatchObject, toContain, a range, a comparison, a toBeGreaterThan, a snapshot, an it.skip, an it.todo, a conditional, or a commented-out block. The non-vacuity guard at :638-640 may not be loosened either. No assertion anywhere in the file may be weakened, disabled or deleted, including assertions this amendment does not name.
PROHIBITIONS.P_EP_4_no_new_allowlist_row: ALLOWLIST (:451 onward) may not gain a row for app/app/portfolios/[portfolioId]/actions.ts or for any other module, and no existing row may be edited or removed. allowlisted stays at 16. An ALLOWLIST row is a documented decision about a module that legitimately cannot open a context; the PF2 module can and must, so a row for it would be a suppression. SERVICE_OWNED_CONTEXTS may not gain an entry for it either.
PROHIBITIONS.P_EP_5_no_change_to_unrelated_entrypoint: Everything in the file other than the two hunks of REGISTRATION_ONLY_SCOPE is out of scope: CONTEXT_OPENERS, reachesDatabaseClient and its cycle handling, valueImports, isClientModule, serverRegions, usesDatabase, opensAContext, databaseSymbols, resolveModule, the AST scanner sections, the mutant fixtures, the versioned-inventory reconciliation tests and the documented-residual-limits tests. No helper may be edited to change what any other module classifies as.
PROHIBITIONS.P_EP_6_no_edit_for_any_other_purpose: The path is authorized for the PF2 actions entry point's registration and derived-total reconciliation ONLY. It is not authorized for PF1 work, for PF3 work, for unrelated drift found while editing, for reformatting, for lint fixes, for import reordering, or for correcting the citation defects this amendment records in OPEN_FINDINGS.
PROHIBITIONS.P_EP_7_no_deletion_or_rename: tests/database-runtime-entrypoints.test.ts may not be deleted, renamed, split, moved or replaced by a generated equivalent.
PROHIBITIONS.P_EP_8_the_move_is_plus_one_plus_one_plu: If a PF2 implementation measures a quadruple other than { 142, 117, 101, 16 } after creating the module, that is a discovery and a STOP, not a licence to write whatever number the suite reports. The authorized figures are fixed here; a different measured figure means either the module does not have the shape this authority requires or the base has drifted, and both are escalations.
PROHIBITIONS.P_EP_9_PF2_production_surface_otherwise_: This amendment changes nothing about the other thirteen paths, their permitted edits or their prohibitions. Every prohibition the base and the successor already carry over app/**, lib/**, db/**, docs/ops/ods/** and the Portfolio pages' unauthenticated / no-selection auth branches remains in force verbatim.
